outcome: Perinatal outcomes (low birth weight, preterm birth, perinatal mortality)
cohort: Pregnant women admitted to Hiwot Fana Comprehensive Specialized University Hospital (HFCSUH) in Eastern Ethiopia from January 1, 2019 to December 31, 2020
finding: The prevalence of PROM was 16.27%, and history of abortion, urinary tract infection, antepartum hemorrhage, and khat chewing during pregnancy were significantly associated with PROM.
